quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric TDnet: Strategic Alliance with Hon Hai Precision Industry for (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Strategic-alliance presentation (Hon Hai Precision Industry, Mitsubishi Electric and Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, October 19, 2026) on the joint operation of the automotive equipment business: the two companies signed an MoU for an alliance in AI data center solutions on November 6, 2025, started considering the joint operation of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility on April 24, 2026 and entered into the definitive agreement on October 16, 2026; the company split agreement is scheduled to be executed during the first half of the fiscal year ending March 2028, with the company split effective and the share transfer closing in October 2027 (scheduled), after which Mitsubishi Electric Mobility is a joint venture owned by Lin Yin International Investment (Hon Hai group, 50%) and Mitsubishi Electric (50%). Mitsubishi Electric Mobility (spun off and established in 2024; approx. 6,400 employees) had revenue of 657.6 billion yen on a non-consolidated basis in FY2026. It will contribute to the development of Hon Hai's EV platform through three areas - autonomous driving, e-powertrain and in-car intelligence. Company target: grow Mitsubishi Electric Mobility into a 1 trillion-yen company by strengthening and expanding its core businesses through the alliance (roadmap: revenue of ¥1 trillion+ as the FY2031 target, with termination of unprofitable businesses and expansion of the solution business).
quarterly_data.figure: Mitsubishi Electric Mobility revenue 657.6 billion yen (FY2026, non-consolidated); revenue target ¥1 trillion+ (FY2031)
